title.narrative: PROTECT L&D-Promoting Resilience and Outreach for Community Transformation with Loss and Damage Schemes

description.narrative:
The proposed project "Promoting Resilience and Outreach for Community Transformation with Loss and Damage Mitigation" project aims to address and mitigate the adverse impacts of climate change-induced loss and damage, adopting a comprehensive approach that integrates economic and non-economic dimensions. The project unfolds through a series of strategic activities to mitigate the climate-induced loss and damage and enhance the adaptive capacity of marginalized communities in the south-west coastal region. The project recognizes the critical role of agriculture in the community's livelihood and addresses the aftermath of cyclone Amphan by promoting climate-smart agriculture. By addressing both economic and non-economic aspects of loss and damage, the project seeks to empower communities to build resilience, ensuring sustainable development in the face of climate change impacts.
Goal: Strengthening community resilience and response mechanisms in the face of unavoidable climate change impacts through locally led initiatives. Overall Objective: Empowering communities to respond to economic & and non-economic loss and damage including future probabilities due to unavoidable impacts of climate change by locally led resilience-building actions. Outcomes: The project anticipates several outcomes: Outcome 1: Improved resilience among vulnerable families through the provision of compensation for the loss and damage of their assets. Outcome 2: Enhanced preparedness and resilience in beneficiaries, empowering them to manage and mitigate future loss and damage effectively. Outcome 3: Successful implementation of grassroot-level projects in vulnerable areas, fostering resilience and sustainable development.
